Aisha: hey team — I'm Aisha, starting today! getting a 'request access' when I try to open the Product team Figma files. can someone add me to the Product team files? thanks!
Maya: welcome Aisha :wave: adding you now. quick onboarding checklist: 1) add to Figma team, 2) join #design, 3) grant Notion read to /product/roadmap. tagging @Sharon in case SSO needs a tweak.
figma-bot: Invite sent to aisha@redwood.com for 'Redwood / Product / Files (2026 Roadmaps)'.
Sharon: hi Aisha — I enabled SSO for your account. try signing out and back in to Figma. if you still see org verification, paste the exact error here and I'll sort it.
Aisha: thanks! I accepted the invite but clicking it opens a blank page that says 'verify organization' and suggests using company SSO. I did the sign-out/in flow once.
Maya: re-sent a direct file link, try this in a new browser tab (or incognito): https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Product-Roadmap?node-id=0%3A1. if that still shows the verify screen, let me know and i'll add you via email ACL.
Tom: hey Aisha — welcome! roadmap & context live in Notion: https://notion.so/redwood/Product-Roadmap. it has the high-level themes + current quarter bets. ping me if you want a 15m walkthrough later. research backlog is in the left nav of that page.
Jordan: for handoffs, we use the eng-handoff template in the handbook: /docs/handbook/eng-handoff.md. make sure exports include component specs and a basic acceptance criteria section. tag me if anything is missing.
Aisha: got the direct link, it opened fine in incognito — thanks Maya. one more thing: where do I find prior research studies, participant lists, and consent templates?
Maya: Research playbook is at https://notion.so/redwood/Research-Playbook. participant pool spreadsheet sits in Research Ops > Participant Pool. consent templates & screener examples are under Research > Templates. also we have a 'research-canvas' study-plan template — copy that for your first study.
Tom: FYI we keep short notes on recruitment constraints and budget per study in the playbook too. happy to share previous recruits if you want a headstart.
Aisha: perfect — i'll copy the canvas and draft a quick plan. also trying to find the design token library in Figma — is it under 'Design System / Tokens'?
Maya: yep — Figma team file 'Design System' > page 'Tokens'. if you want editor access to that file i'll grant it after the Product files are confirmed.
Sharon: all SSO bits look green on my end now. if you still see anything odd, DM me the screenshot and i'll raise a support ticket.
Aisha: everything's working now, and i can see the roadmap + design system. booked a 15m with Tom at 3pm to sync priorities. thanks everyone :pray:
Maya: awesome — welcome aboard! :tada: i'll close this thread but re-open if anything else pops up.
